correctness.rationale: The five rows match Proposition 4.1. Independent hyperplane/coset augmentation (not the frozen RREF enumeration) generated 121, 1210, 1210, 121, 1 nonzero-dimensional ternary message spaces. Summing all word weights on each and dividing by 2·3^(r−1) exactly reproduced every histogram bin and hierarchy (14,19,22,24,25). The Gram map is nonsingular, and the 25 projective columns are distinct. Independent incidence counting on every 3-space reproduced all six labeled common-zero sets, the plane histogram, five incidences at coordinate 2 and the pair counts 7, 2, 6. The four projective word weights in each optimum are 14,14,14,15; each occupied coordinate contributes to three weights, proving the general lower bound 19.
residual_risks: Scope is this fixed generator and coordinate labeling; no classification of all ternary [25,5,14] LCD codes.
